title: Why this group
text: Why are you interested in this research group?

options.text: Your recent work addresses a question I met in practice. I would like to connect that experience with stronger methods.
options.response: 动机与具体经历建立了联系，也说明了希望补足什么。

options.text: Your university is the highest ranked option on my list.
options.response: 声誉可以是因素，但这个回答没有体现研究匹配。

options.text: I think I can learn many things here.
options.response: 态度积极，仍需要更具体地说明学习目标。
